positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Led the development of a team-based assignments epic, enhancing user collaboration and productivity throughout organizational applications.
- Drove the company-wide adoption of my team’s standardized authentication utility, improving security and streamlining integration processes across teams.
- Directed the implementation of i18n across all the team’s customer-facing repositories, enabling seamless localization and expanding global user accessibility.
- Spearheaded the development of an external document-sharing system, streamlining customer interactions and enhancing user experience through secure and intuitive interfaces.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led a cross-functional team refactoring of a monolithic internal tools system, successfully migrating services into scalable, cost-effective and security approved AWS Lambda functions.
- Bridged the divide between developers and SDETs at the company by reinforcing strong testing habits and knowledge sharing of automated testing techniques and principles.
- Mentored junior developers by providing code reviews, conducting knowledge-sharing sessions, and fostering professional growth within the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test III
positions.description:
•	Established coding patterns in node.js for API and UI tests
•	Tested in a micro-services architecture that uses React, AWS, and Terraform
•	Worked closely with developers and product managers to create tests earlier in the development cycle
•	Was in charge of a separate node.js project to build a data management tool to help all of FQ Engineering
•	Interviewed candidates to help build the engineering department and company culture
•	Established QE methodologies and practices for team
•	Assisted in the deployment process of releases through jenkins

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Ran diligent regression testing on web, iOS, Android, and kiosk platforms
•	Managed team priorities using JIRA and Confluence
•	Established strong communication skills with remote developers based in Chicago, IL
•	Coordinated with Product Managers, Development, and QA to execute goals in an Agile environment

positions.title: QA Engineer - Mobile Application
positions.description:
•	Develop test plans and test cases for the ScoreBig Mobile Application
•	Work quickly and effectively in JIRA to respond to defects in the app
•	Coordinate with Product, Development, and QA to execute goals in an Agile system
•	Write and maintain automation tests for the mobile app
•	Utilize Microsoft SQL, Sumo Logic, and mTAIL to investigate issues and use best judgement to problem solve

positions.title: Data Specialist
positions.description:
•	Utilize Microsoft SQL to query the ScoreBig database for significant data analysis and research
•	Implement team building tactics with the branch in Manila to help build the database in the most efficient way possible
 •	Use Adobe Illustrator to create images used on the ScoreBig website for customer purchasing experiences
•	Lead and coordinate data teams to meet deadlines on projects

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
•	Conducted an in depth analysis upon light emitting diodes and disease carrying insects for public health initiatives.
•	Formulated experimental setup and design for the year-long research project.
•	Successfully categorized and statistically evaluated over 5,579 insects by hand.
• Teamed with group members to write and submit research paper for publishing in the Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences journal.

positions.title: Cashier/Stocker
positions.description:
•	Effectively balanced duties of serving customers and keeping inventory stocked.
•	Managed workplace environment with autonomous judgment.
•	Handled customer service relations with utmost professionalism; diffusing situations with care when necessary.
•	Achieved comfort in high-pressure high-stress environments.

positions.title: Lifeguard
positions.description:
•	Designed lesson plans for children ages 4-12 to learn the basics of swimming.
•	Upheld emergency standards and safety protocols for the camp’s multiple pools.
•	Honored with the Lifeguard of the Week Award for excellence in lifeguarding.
•	Managed the interpersonal relations between myself, young children, and ambitious parents.

educations.schoolName: University of California, Berkeley, Haas School of Business
